about: todo-touch.md 8.1: a device of ours for the bench Harmony Touch, composed by composeTouchDeviceOfRow in packages/codec/src/families/harmony-touch/compose.ts from the rhythm table's Sony 12 Bit row and numbers chosen here, with no catalogue behind it. Sony 12 Bit because its definition, as definitionOfRow writes it, has the shape of the Sony 20 Bit definition the bench Touch already sends for its Blu-ray (one header, two cells, a 45 ms frame period, the key code in the repeat group), differing in the width alone, and a 12 cell frame cannot be heard as a 20 cell one. The numbers are the family's usual fields, a seven bit command and a five bit address, each sent least significant bit first and written here in the order they are sent: commands 1 to 11 at address 30, which no bench remote's configuration holds, packages/corpus/test/touch-device-set.test.ts. A projector, type 7, which the screens name and draw with the default picture, as they draw five of the bench set's seven devices. Ids of ours, OWN_IDS.
